objective: Make the start-branch skip rule in startBranch apply only when the clone settled on the repository's default branch, as its doc comment says.
scope: Review finding (non-blocking), packages/runtime/src/cli/status.ts about lines 36-41: the rule skips a first reflog move from a full commit id when the next move leaves that move's destination, but never checks that the destination is the default branch. A session that starts detached, goes to B, then to C reports C instead of B.

Add the check: the skipped move's destination must be the default branch, read from refs/remotes/origin/HEAD (git symbolic-ref -q refs/remotes/origin/HEAD, stripping refs/remotes/origin/); when origin/HEAD is missing, do not skip, so the old behavior holds. Use the module's existing git helpers.

Add a test in packages/runtime/tests/cloud-checkout.test.ts for the detached -> B -> C reflog where B is not the default branch: the start branch stays B. It must fail without the check. Make sure the existing platform-shape test sets origin/HEAD so it keeps passing.

Make no git writes (no commit, add, checkout, stash, branch) and no edits under .git/ or .holyagent/; the root commits. Report your changed paths.
